root_review: root实际逐项读600个现存en、中文义、完整词典及1200组双语，再逐项审读三份冻结作者稿的130项建议；所有建议与本词语境及所核来源对应，全部接受，无额外root改动。所有作者及整批审读冻结后才apply。

root_sources_checked.supports: 脑震荡为脑损伤，不以失去意识作为必要条件；只作术语辨识。
DER是ASN.1编码规则，受约束以产生唯一编码形式。
道尔顿单位为碳12原子质量的十二分之一，不是普通姓氏锁定某科学家。

boundaries: 仅en辅助定义；学习ID、词头、中文义、音标、完整原词典和全部例句保持。
Thorpe、Goodman、Riley在普通姓名语境不锁定唯一历史人物，清en回退既有中文题。
450个正确基本定义和20个原空保持，不为列全多义扩写。
覆盖不是全库专业语言审校，未验收真人音频。

changes.before: one of a series of rounded projections (or the notches between them) formed by curves along an edge (as the edge of a leaf or piece of cloth or the margin of a shell or a shriveled red blood cell observed in a hypertonic solution etc.)
changes.after: an edible marine shellfish with two ribbed, fan-shaped shells
changes.reason: 旧定义是边缘的一段圆弧装饰；菜里的扇贝及扇贝壳都需要动物义。

changes.before: pass through the tissue or substance or its pores or interstices, as of gas
changes.after: to become known or be discovered; to happen
changes.reason: 旧定义是气体穿过组织或孔隙；票寄错地址被发现和会议发生事情都不是蒸腾或透过材料。

changes.before: produced or growing in extreme abundance
changes.after: full of energy, excitement, or enthusiasm
changes.reason: 旧定义是繁茂生长或大量产出；热情欢迎和畅快笑声均指充沛活力。

changes.before: someone who is or has been segregated
changes.after: to separate people or things from others, sometimes according to a particular characteristic
changes.reason: 旧定义是被隔离的人；隔离学生和分开回收材料都是动词分隔。

changes.before: a form of baptism in which part or all of a person's body is submerged
changes.after: deep involvement in an activity or subject, or being put fully into a liquid
changes.reason: 旧定义限定浸礼；沉浸语言学习和专心读书均不是洗礼仪式。

changes.before: a unit of power equal to 746 watts
changes.after: a unit of power used for engines, with one mechanical unit equal to about 746 watts
changes.reason: 旧定义未区分马力制式且写成精确746瓦；NIST机械马力约745.6999瓦，改为明确机械制式和约数。

changes.before: in an insincerely false manner
changes.after: in a way that is untrue or incorrect
changes.reason: 旧定义必带不真诚；错误指控未必出于明知撒谎，需保留不实或错误这个核心而不猜动机。

changes.before: v call to arms; of military personnel
changes.after: to organise people or bring resources together for action
changes.reason: 旧定义只限军人入伍；动员清理志愿者和调集防风暴资源都不是军事征召。

changes.before: a swift and violent military offensive with intensive aerial bombardment
changes.after: a concentrated burst of activity intended to achieve something quickly
changes.reason: 旧定义限猛烈空袭；厨房清理和多平台密集宣传都指短时集中行动。

changes.before: a large sea wave
changes.after: to rise or move in large rolling masses, or swell outward
changes.reason: 旧定义是大海浪；烟升起和窗帘鼓动均是滚动涌出或鼓起的动词。

changes.before: a clamp for holding pieces of wood together while they are glued
changes.after: a painful tightening of a muscle; to restrict movement or activity
changes.reason: 旧定义是木工夹具；腿部抽筋和桌边空间限制动作均不适用夹具义。

changes.before: English chemist and physicist who formulated atomic theory and the law of partial pressures; gave the first description of red-green color blindness (1766-1844)
changes.after: an atomic-scale mass unit equal to one twelfth of the mass of a carbon-12 atom
changes.reason: 旧定义锁定科学家John Dalton；单位场景可可靠定义，普通Mr Dalton不认定历史人物。完整词典旧氧原子标准不在本次修改范围。

changes.before: Venetian traveler who explored Asia in the 13th century and served Kublai Khan (1254-1324)
changes.after: a sport in which players on horseback hit a ball with long mallets; also used for a collared casual shirt
changes.reason: 旧定义是旅行家Marco Polo；翻领短袖衫与马球比赛均不指该历史人物。

changes.before: an irrational but irresistible motive for a belief or action
changes.after: extreme enthusiasm for something; a clinical state of unusually elevated or irritable mood and increased energy
changes.reason: 旧定义把狂热或躁狂归为不可抗拒的非理性动机；日常热潮与临床异常情绪、活力需区分，NIMH及词典支持。

changes.before: n the chief executive department of the United States government
changes.after: An informal word for a senior manager in a company or other organization.
changes.reason: 旧义是美国政府行政部门，错配口语高管；两句均为公司职位。

changes.before: sends a firework display high into the sky
changes.after: To rise very rapidly, especially in price or amount.
changes.reason: 旧义为把焰火送上天空，错配需求和价格飞涨的动词。

changes.before: English general; son of George II; fought unsuccessfully in the battle of Fontenoy (1721-1765)
changes.after: A historic county in northwestern England, whose name is also used for a type of sausage.
changes.reason: 旧义指乔治二世之子，实际中文和两句明确为历史地区及香肠名称；据英国政府资料改为地名性质。

changes.before: an ardent male lover
changes.after: The young male lover in Shakespeare's tragedy about two lovers from feuding families.
changes.reason: 普通名词热情男情人的旧义未辨明本条的剧中角色；两句均谈舞台角色，按皇家莎士比亚剧团资料说明性质，不把一般人名绑定人物。

changes.before: any substance used to slow down neutrons in nuclear reactors
changes.after: A person who leads a discussion or makes sure an online discussion follows its rules.
changes.reason: 旧义仅为核反应堆慢化剂，完全错配主持人和论坛管理者。

changes.before: a British imperial capacity unit (liquid or dry) equal to 5 fluid ounces or 142.066 cubic centimeters
changes.after: An organ used by fish to breathe in water, or a thin plate beneath a mushroom cap.
changes.reason: 旧义为容量单位，与鱼鳃和蘑菇菌褶两句均不符；用 or 分列两个性质。

changes.before: a depression scratched or carved into a surface
changes.after: A cut made in the body during surgery.
changes.reason: 旧义指表面划痕或刻痕；两句是手术切口，按 NCI 明确医学辨识义。

changes.before: the branch of psychiatry concerned with psychological methods
changes.after: Treatment of emotional or mental difficulties through psychological methods, often involving talking.
changes.reason: 旧义将治疗本身说成精神病学分支；NIMH 说明它是多种治疗，改为术语性质，不给治疗建议。

changes.before: a disorder in one's mental state
changes.after: A departure from what is normal or expected; in optics, a flaw that distorts an image.
changes.reason: 旧义只指精神状态障碍，错配偶然失常和镜头像差；正常偏离与光学义分列。

changes.before: a well-built sexually attractive man
changes.after: A large, thick piece of something.
changes.reason: 旧义为健壮性感男子，实际中文与两句都指面包、石头的大块。

changes.before: tough elastic tissue; mostly converted to bone in adults
changes.after: Tough, flexible tissue that supports parts of the body and covers the ends of bones in joints.
changes.reason: 旧义把成年后大部分转化为骨作为概括，易混同生长过程与成年软骨组织；NCI 明确成年身体仍有支撑、关节软骨。

changes.before: n a sudden and violent collapse
changes.after: An event or plan that fails completely, often in an embarrassing way.
changes.reason: 旧义的突然猛烈倒塌没有准确表达活动彻底失败；两句为派对和发布搞砸。

changes.before: an inability to resist the gratification of whims and desires
changes.after: A pleasure you allow yourself, or the act of enjoying it.
changes.reason: 旧义把满足欲望定义成无法抗拒；周末点心等小享受并不要求失控，词典把自许享受列为基本义。

changes.before: a vast treeless plain in the Arctic regions where the subsoil is permanently frozen
changes.after: A cold, mostly treeless environment in polar regions or high mountains, with low-growing plants.
changes.reason: 旧义限定北极平原及永久冻土；NPS 明确有高山苔原，冻土在高山苔原分布并不普遍。

changes.before: the act (or an instance) of subjecting a body or substance to the impact of high-energy particles (as electrons or alpha rays)
changes.after: Repeated attacks with bombs or guns, or a large amount of unwanted information directed at someone.
changes.reason: 旧义只为高能粒子轰击，错配战争轰炸和密集广告。

changes.before: the act of pouncing
changes.after: To jump or move suddenly toward something to catch or attack it.
changes.reason: 旧义仅用自身变形 pouncing 循环解释，没有交代猛扑动作；补足突然移近捕捉或攻击的辨识信息。

changes.before: musically pleasing
changes.after: Peaceful and friendly, or combining well in a pleasing way.
changes.reason: 旧义仅为音乐悦耳；两句是颜色协调和工作关系和谐。

changes.before: illusory perception; a common symptom of severe mental disorder
changes.after: An experience of seeing, hearing, or otherwise sensing something that is not actually present.
changes.reason: 旧义以严重精神障碍作主要提示，且泛说虚幻感知；NHS 列多种原因，包括暂时状态。定义只描述不存在外部对象的感知，不推断病因。

changes.before: at or on or to the masthead or upper rigging of a ship
changes.after: In the air or high above the ground.
changes.reason: 旧义限船舶桅顶或上部索具，错配空中风筝和高举奖杯。

changes.before: an increase to counteract a perceived discrepancy
changes.after: A rise in the amount, intensity, or seriousness of something.
changes.reason: 旧义限定为抵消感知差异而增加，错配冲突升级与成本增加。

changes.before: not characterized by a fixed principle or rate; at irregular intervals
changes.after: A departure from a usual shape, pattern, or accepted rule.
changes.reason: 旧义用形容词及副词描述间隔，不是异常或不规则现象的名词；改为可指账目异常和瓷砖形态差异的定义。

changes.before: a cartoon character created by Walt Disney
changes.after: Silly, often in a funny or amusing way.
changes.reason: 旧义是迪士尼角色，实际中文和两句均为非正式形容词。

changes.before: n a hard grey lustrous metallic element that is highly resistant to corrosion; occurs in niobite and fergusonite and tantalite
changes.after: An informal British expression used to thank someone.
changes.reason: 旧义取元素钽的符号 Ta，实际是英式口语感谢。

changes.before: a device that controls amount of light admitted
changes.after: An opening, especially the one in a camera that lets light through.
changes.reason: 旧义把开口误说成控制光量的装置，混淆光圈孔径和装置；两句都可由开口性质辨识。

changes.before: the mistake of not following suit when able to do so
changes.after: To officially cancel permission, a decision, or an agreement.
changes.reason: 旧义是牌戏中未跟花色的犯规，错配吊销执照和撤销访问权限。

changes.before: a cut of meat (beef or veal or mutton or lamb) from the upper part of the leg
changes.after: The lower part of a leg or meat from it; also the long, narrow part of a tool.
changes.reason: 旧义把腿肉位置说成 upper part；词典说明尤其膝下，羊小腿译文与此一致；工具柄部另列。

changes.before: s (of soil) soft and watery
changes.after: Very wet and often soft from soaking up water.
changes.reason: 旧义括号限定土壤，不能解释两句中的鞋和三明治；改为吸水湿透或湿软的常用性质。

changes.before: not yet payable
changes.after: Beyond what is necessary, reasonable, or justified.
changes.reason: 旧义仅为支付未到期，错配过度压力及不必要耽搁。

changes.before: needed encouragement
changes.after: An action or remark that causes anger or is meant to trigger a reaction.
changes.reason: 旧义为所需鼓励，不能解释无故大喊和挑衅；改为激怒或引起反应的行为话语。

changes.before: n (biology) the structural adaptation of some body part for a particular function
changes.after: A particular field of study or work, or the process of focusing on that field.
changes.reason: 旧义取生物学部位适应专职功能；实际两句是学习专攻方向，注明英式词形的普通领域义。

changes.before: an article deposited as security
changes.after: One of the eight small chess pieces on each side, or a person used by others for their own aims.
changes.reason: 旧义仅为抵押品，两句实际是国际象棋兵与被利用者；用 or 明示不同义。

changes.before: A large wicker basket.
changes.after: An informal British word for the penis, often used by children.
changes.reason: 旧义为大柳条篮，与中文及两句词语辨识不符；只给英式非正式身体部位用语性质。

changes.before: English navigator remembered for his exploration of the Pacific coast of North America (1757-1798)
changes.after: A city in British Columbia on Canada's west coast.
changes.reason: 旧义绑定英国航海家；第一句明确加拿大城市，官方市政府资料可定位，改城市性质。

changes.before: a condition of disability resulting from the loss of one or more limbs
changes.after: The surgical removal of all or part of a limb or another body part.
changes.reason: 旧义指失去肢体后的残疾状态，把手术和结果混同；NHS 明确切除身体部位，两句指手术及其恢复。
